name: io.github.xiaobinger/qrcode-mcp
description: Local MCP server that decodes and repairs damaged QR codes, generates QR codes, safely routes QR URLs and runs pluggable OCR (Windows OCR / RapidOCR / Tesseract).

environmentVariables.name: QRMCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where generated images are written. Defaults to ./out

environmentVariables.name: QRMCP_URL_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed hostnames for qr_open. Wildcards such as *.example.com are supported. Empty means all public hosts are allowed with explicit confirmation.

environmentVariables.name: QRMCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token required by the HTTP and SSE transports.

environmentVariables.name: QRMCP_ALLOW_REMOTE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow fetching images from http(s) URLs. Disabled by default to prevent SSRF.
